article.full_text: OTT platforms are gearing up with a whole bunch of new releases, from action-packed thrillers to heartwarming romcoms. Are you perplexed by the choices and wondering what and where to watch? Vi users can enjoy an unparalleled range of content in English or other Indian regional languages and watch their favourite movies or shows on smartphones and TVs. Get a Vi OTT prepaid or postpaid pack and enjoy memberships to leading OTT platforms along with all the telco benefits. To know more about Vi OTT Prepaid Plans or postpaid plans, scroll down. Here is an updated list of OTT releases this week that you can add to your watch list. When it comes to professional wrestling, things cannot get better than WWE. With Netflix streaming all formats of the show live in India, you can now follow your favourite wrestling stars live without having to wait for re-runs and highlights. The IndianOil Durand Cup 2026 marks the 135th edition of Asia’s oldest football tournament. Organised by the Durand Football Tournament Society in collaboration with the AIFF and the Indian Army’s Eastern Command, the prestigious competition brings together top clubs from across India in a celebration of the nation’s rich footballing heritage. When Leela is separated from her tour group in Varanasi, she unexpectedly finds companionship in Madhavan. As they journey together, the two rediscover hope, warmth, and the simple joys of life through an unexpected bond. The Devil Wears Prada 2 follows Miranda Priestly as she faces off against her former assistant, Emily Charlton, now a powerful executive. As the two rivals battle for advertising revenue in the declining print media industry, Miranda must also confront the prospect of retirement. Five friends venture into Thailand’s Devil’s Mouth cave system for one final adventure before adulthood begins. But when a deadly underwater predator starts hunting them, their thrilling expedition turns into a terrifying fight for survival where every decision could be their last. HeartBeat Season 3 returns to RK Multispeciality Hospital with Reena embracing a bold new chapter as "Reena 2.0" and Radhi settling into a full-time role. As fresh interns join the team, new challenges, relationships, and emotions bring renewed energy to the hospital. A happily engaged couple’s dream wedding week takes an unexpected turn when unforeseen events throw their plans into chaos. As emotions run high and tensions rise, they must navigate the turmoil to determine if their relationship can withstand the ultimate test. The Legend of Karna follows the extraordinary journey of Karna, a charioteer’s son who rises to greatness in Hastinapura. As loyalty, destiny, and a long-hidden secret shape his path, he is drawn toward the epic conflict that will define his legacy. Missed last week’s hottest OTT releases? Here’s a quick recap for you: The final of the FIFA World Cup 2026 is finally here! Watch Spain take on Argentina on ZEE5 to find out the ultimate winner. Fifteen years after discovering the Sword of Power, Adam returns to Eternia to find it under Skeletor’s rule. Joined by Teela and Duncan, he must embrace his destiny as He-Man, unlock his true power, and fight to save his world and the people he loves. Star Trek: Strange New Worlds follows Captain Pike, Science Officer Spock, and Number One as they embark on thrilling missions aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Together, they explore uncharted worlds, encounter new civilizations, and face extraordinary adventures across the galaxy. After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic bookstore owner Stuart Bloom embarks on a chaotic mission to find a quantum interference device and restore reality. Along the way, he must navigate bizarre alternate worlds and unexpected challenges before it's too late. Set in 1958 Kerala, Pallichattambi follows Krishna Pillai, a carefree rowdy whose life takes a dramatic turn as he transforms into the feared and influential Pallichattambi. The film traces his rise amid power, conflict, and changing times. Musafir Cafe follows Chander, whose deep connection with Sudha continues to haunt him even after he starts a new life in the hills with Preeti. As memories of the past resurface, he must confront love, loss, and the choices that shaped his journey. Set in a dysfunctional Delhi government school, Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya follows a laidback headmaster whose dream of a fully funded Cambridge trip sparks a chaotic transformation. Alongside an eccentric team of teachers, he sets out to fix a broken education system, one classroom lesson at a time. Kay Kay Menon, Naveen Kasturia, Abhimanyu Singh, Archana Puran Singh Con City is a crime comedy about four former criminals who reinvent themselves as a middle-class family while running a small hotel in Karnataka. story.title: The Remote Between Us
story.skipLabel: Skip this week’s OTT release scramble

creativeDirection.dramaticPremise: On the night before a family wedding, a young woman needs her phone’s data for an urgent video upload while her brother wants to stream the week’s OTT releases; a new Vi add-on pack turns their argument into one risky final choice.

dramaticSpine.characterGoal: Naina wants to upload the wedding video before midnight, while Arjun wants to choose and watch one new OTT release immediately.
dramaticSpine.obstacle: Their data is nearly exhausted, and the wedding video is still unfinished.
dramaticSpine.newsCatalyst: The new ₹200 Vi Movies & TV App Add-On Pack offers access to 20 OTT platforms, 30 GB of data, and 28-day validity; compatible 5G users in Vi 5G coverage areas can get Unlimited 5G.
dramaticSpine.reversal: The pack makes streaming possible, but Arjun discovers that Naina’s phone is the only device with enough battery to finish the upload.
dramaticSpine.costOfFailure: The wedding video may miss its midnight delivery, while Arjun loses his chance to watch the chosen release tonight.
dramaticSpine.emotionalTurn: Arjun stops treating the pack as a streaming excuse and uses the extra data to help Naina finish the family video.
dramaticSpine.resolution: They buy the add-on, upload the video together, and postpone their OTT choice until the upload is safe.

visualBible.setting: A cramped, colourful apartment living room on the eve of a wedding, with half-packed suitcases, flower garlands, a charging cable stretched across the floor, and two phones beside a laptop.
visualBible.colorAndLighting: Warm marigold string lights and soft teal evening shadows; the room begins hectic and orange, then settles into a calmer golden glow after the upload succeeds.
recurringProps: Naina’s lavender phone with a cracked corner
A laptop showing an unfinished wedding video without readable text
Half-packed suitcase with bright fabric spilling out
visualBible.storyArc: The room begins as a tug-of-war over one phone and one dwindling data connection, becomes a frantic race against the upload, and ends with both siblings sharing the headphones while the wedding video sends.
visualBible.referenceImagePrompt: Editorial animated-film still of Naina and Arjun together in a cluttered Indian apartment living room before a wedding, Naina in a yellow kurta with lavender phone, Arjun in a green hoodie with oversized headphones, marigold garlands, half-packed suitcase, laptop, charging cable, warm orange string lights with teal shadows, expressive faces, cinematic depth, clean upper-third space for captions, no text, logos, or watermark.

cast.voiceProfile: Warm, quick Indian English voice with clipped sentences and controlled panic; begins practical and impatient, uses tiny pauses before escalating, then softens into relieved affectionate laughter by the ending.
cast.visualIdentity: Animated young Indian woman in a mustard-yellow kurta, cobalt bangles, loose braid, lavender phone with a cracked corner.

cast.role: Younger brother campaigning for an immediate binge
cast.voiceProfile: Playful low-energy Indian English voice with a teasing rhythm and dry comic timing; starts smug, breaks into nervous urgency when the upload stalls, and ends warmly conspiratorial.
cast.visualIdentity: Animated young Indian man in an oversized forest-green hoodie, red shorts, messy hair, oversized black headphones around his neck.

beats.dramaticAction: Arjun lunges for the remote as Naina blocks the television with her laptop.
beats.turningPoint: Their ordinary wedding-night argument becomes a contest over the week’s OTT releases.

visual.caption: This week’s OTT releases turn a wedding eve into a remote-control war.
visual.imagePrompt: Editorial animated-film shot of Arjun lunging toward a remote while Naina shields a laptop in the wedding-cluttered living room, marigold lights, lavender phone visible, medium two-shot, warm orange light with teal window shadows, comic tension, clear upper-third caption space, no text, logos, or watermark.
visual.scenePrompt: Continuous opening shot: Arjun reaches across the sofa, Naina pivots between him and the television, wedding preparations visibly unfinished.
visual.continuityNotes: Establish both siblings, the laptop, phone, headphones, garlands, and suitcase; preserve all props for the next shot.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: This week’s OTT releases are here—WWE live on Netflix, Durand Cup 2026, and Devil Wears Prada 2. Pick one!

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Pick the wedding video first. It has to upload before midnight.

beats.dramaticAction: Naina starts the upload; Arjun snatches the charging cable and plugs it into his streaming phone.
beats.turningPoint: Both devices compete for the only reliable cable while the upload crawls.

visual.caption: One cable. Two emergencies.
visual.imagePrompt: Animated-film close two-shot of Naina launching an upload on the laptop while Arjun yanks the charging cable toward his phone, cable stretched like a tug-of-war rope, suitcase and garlands behind them, dramatic warm light, frantic comic mood, upper-third space, no text, logos, or watermark.
visual.scenePrompt: The camera tracks the cable from laptop to Arjun’s phone as both siblings pull in opposite directions.
visual.continuityNotes: Naina remains standing behind the laptop; Arjun stays crouched by the sofa; the lavender phone and headphones remain visible.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: My data is dying. Arjun, give me the cable.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I am researching responsibly. Five friends, a cave, a deadly underwater predator—this is urgent.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: That is not research. That is you hiding from folding clothes.

beats.dramaticAction: Arjun releases the cable, opens the Vi app, and freezes when Naina reads the new pack details aloud.
beats.turningPoint: The ₹200 add-on makes both streaming and the upload possible, but only if they spend part of their wedding budget.

visual.caption: The new add-on brings 20 OTT platforms, 30 GB, and 28-day validity.
visual.imagePrompt: Editorial animated-film medium shot of Arjun holding the phone toward Naina while she leans over it, their faces lit by a soft blue glow, wedding room still cluttered, marigold highlights, cautious hope, upper-third caption-safe space, no text, logos, or watermark.
visual.scenePrompt: Arjun turns from the cable to the phone and shows Naina the offer; the laptop upload indicator continues moving in the background without readable interface text.
visual.continuityNotes: Keep the cable in Naina’s hand and Arjun’s headphones around his neck; advance the laptop upload slightly but do not show legible text.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Wait. The new ₹200 Vi add-on gives 20 OTT platforms, 30 GB, and 28-day validity.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Thirty gigabytes could save the upload. Or your entire personality for twenty-eight days.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: It also says compatible 5G devices in Vi 5G coverage can get Unlimited 5G.

beats.dramaticAction: Naina checks the phone’s battery and the upload suddenly stalls; Arjun reaches for the laptop as his own phone dies.
beats.turningPoint: The plan stops being a luxury: Naina’s phone is the only device capable of finishing the wedding delivery.

visual.caption: The binge can wait; the deadline cannot.
visual.imagePrompt: Animated-film dramatic close-up of Naina’s worried face beside the stalled laptop, while Arjun’s phone goes dark in his hand and he reaches for the laptop, golden string lights flickering across both faces, tense but tender mood, upper-third space, no text, logos, or watermark.
visual.scenePrompt: The upload freezes mid-action; Arjun’s screen dims; he silently hands his headphones to Naina and moves beside the laptop.
visual.continuityNotes: The same room and positions continue; the cable now powers the laptop, while Arjun’s phone remains dark and the suitcase stays open.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: My phone just died. Yours is the only one with battery.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: So you finally admit my phone is the main character?

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Tonight, yes. Buy the pack. I’ll finish the video.

beats.dramaticAction: Naina taps to buy the add-on, and Arjun trims the video while she holds the phone near the window for the connection.
beats.turningPoint: They sacrifice tonight’s binge to protect the wedding deadline, turning the OTT choice into a shared rescue mission.

visual.caption: The watchlist waits. The wedding video goes first.
visual.imagePrompt: Editorial animated-film final wide shot of Naina holding her lavender phone by the open window while Arjun edits beside the laptop, headphones shared between them, marigold lights glowing, suitcase now partly closed, relieved laughter, warm golden lighting, generous upper-third caption space, no text, logos, or watermark.
visual.scenePrompt: The upload bar reaches completion as Naina and Arjun exchange one headphone each; Arjun closes the laptop and pushes the remote away.
visual.continuityNotes: Preserve every character costume and prop; the laptop closes only after the upload completes, ending the continuous scene with the remote untouched.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Bought. Now cut the uncle’s twelve-minute speech.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Tonight, the wedding wins. Tomorrow, we choose between caves, hospitals, romance, and WWE.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Deal. But I’m keeping the remote.

story.exit: The laptop closes after the wedding video uploads, leaving the siblings laughing over a postponed OTT night and one carefully guarded remote.
